pkgTitle: Warm starts for external and coupled units
title: Accept ADR 0070 (and ADR 0019 Amendment 15): declared warm starts
body: A solve may declare a starting point taken from an earlier solution, recorded in the run so it replays. Measured: restarting a coupled run from the same design's solution takes 1 reactor iteration instead of 4 (25 s instead of 194 s).

Two claims were withdrawn after measurement (questions Q1 and Q7 under Defaults): the reactor's own warm-start variant was about 21 % slower, and starting from a neighbouring design did not save iterations.
unblocks: X02 merges (it is built, tested and green on CI).
